guide.title: Guide
guide.heroTitle: How to use Website + WhatsApp Bot
guide.heroSubtitle: This guide is for operations admins: follow the flow, use the example templates, then check the results on the dashboard.
steps: Receive an order from the customer or owner.
Input the order via the Internal Arasya WhatsApp group or the Create Order button on the website.
Check the order in the Orders menu: PIC, service detail, route, car, driver, and price.
Assign driver/car per day in the Schedule menu. Multi-day orders can change the driver each day.
Check driver availability (FREE/BUSY) in Schedule before assigning to avoid clashes.
Generate the invoice from Order Detail.
Send the invoice PDF to the customer's WhatsApp from the Invoices menu.
The driver sends trip reports/photos to the bot.
Set the status each day in Schedule (SCHEDULED -> IN_PROGRESS -> DONE).
The order is complete once all days are DONE and the data is final.
websiteMenuParas: Orders is the operational hub. Click an order for detail, edit the order, and generate the invoice.
Schedule manages driver/car assignment per day and checks driver availability. Customers stores customer data automatically, External stores outside vendors/drivers.
Forms are used to input/edit data. If a required field is empty, the system shows an error.
Service Detail Rows are the service/route lines. Each row becomes an invoice line item and counts toward the total.
Tables are data lists. Use search, action buttons, or click the row/chevron to open detail.
Colored badges show status such as AVAILABLE, ASSIGNED, ISSUED, PAID, SENT, or FAILED.

websiteCases.d: Fill in PIC, Booking, main pickup/dropoff, then add Service Detail. If there are several days/routes, create several rows.
Use when there is a price/route change. If the price changes and an invoice already exists, write the reason so it is recorded.
Pick a driver and car from the list. Unit codes like ARA/FCB/VLZ help find a car quickly.
Create the invoice once the order total is correct. The PDF is generated automatically and can be previewed.
If the order changes after the invoice is made, use revise/sync invoice. The old invoice stays as history.
In the Invoices menu, expand the row, choose the recipient, then Send PDF via WhatsApp. The history is saved.
Add/edit master data. For internal drivers, store the real phone so the WhatsApp tag can match the database.

guide.scheduleIntro: The Schedule menu manages assignment per day, not per order. This is how an order that runs several days can use a different driver each day.

scheduleCases.d: The Agenda tab shows one row per day per order. Filter by date, driver, type (Internal/External), and status.
Click Edit on a row to pick driver+car (internal) or vendor+car (external) for that day only. Multi-day orders may use a different driver each day.
Each day has its own status: SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, CANCELLED. Change it as the trip progresses.
The Driver Availability tab shows FREE/BUSY per driver for the selected date, computed from the schedule (not order status). Use this before assigning to avoid clashes.

customerCases.d: The customer is saved automatically when an order is created (from WhatsApp or website), matched by phone number.
Open the customer detail to see total orders and the list of previous orders. Useful for repeat customers.
Add tags (e.g. VIP, Corporate) and notes for important customer info.

externalCases.d: The External menu stores outside vendors/drivers and their cars (one vendor can have many cars).
When an external order is created from WhatsApp (driver as name + phone + origin), the vendor and car are created automatically, then can be tidied up here.
When assigning an external day in Schedule, pick the vendor and car from the list already saved here.

guide.invoiceGenerateDesc: Create the invoice once the order total is correct. The PDF will be available for preview and sending.
guide.invoiceSendPdfDesc: In the Invoices menu, expand the row, choose the customer/PIC, add an optional note, then send the PDF via WhatsApp.
guide.invoiceHistoryDesc: Each send is saved: recipient, number, SENT/FAILED status, error, and View PDF.
guide.serviceTypesIntro: The Service options follow Arasya's current operational packages: ALL INCLUDED, 12 HOURS, and FULL DAY. Use the price reference below to set the amount per service row.
guide.botTriggerWarnTitle: You must use a keyword at the start of the message.
guide.botTriggerWarnBody: The bot ignores all normal chat. For text, photos, PDFs, and documents, the caption/message must start with a keyword. Case does not matter: #START, #Start, and #start are treated the same.

botWakeKeywords.d: Admin creates a new order from the Internal Arasya group.
Driver starts moving / arrives at pickup / starts work. Can be text, photo, or document with a caption.
Driver reports drop-off/customer alighting. Does not close the order. For multi-drop/multi-day, still use #drop then write the drop number in the message: #drop 1, #drop 2, etc.
Driver finishes the work and closes the order/trip.

guide.multiDropNote: Multi-drop / multi-day: do not create new keywords like #drop1 or #drop2. Keep using #drop, then write the drop number after the keyword or in the message. Example: #drop 1, #drop 2, #drop 3. All drops only save reports; the order is closed only with #finish.
guide.captionNote: Photos/documents without a keyword caption are not processed. Correct example: send a photo with caption #start, #drop, #drop 1, or #finish.
guide.internalDriverDesc: Use a short name or tag. The bot matches the database to get the full name, phone, type, and base.
guide.externalDriverDesc: Must write the name, WhatsApp number, and origin/base. Do not use a tag for external.
guide.tbaDesc: Allowed for locations/times not yet confirmed. The first day should be complete.
guide.botChatExamplesTitle: WhatsApp order chat examples for various cases
guide.driverReportTitle: Driver report examples to the bot

keywords.d: Customer or person-in-charge data that can be contacted.
When the order was made. On the website it automatically uses the order creation time; on WhatsApp it can be written if the order is old/needs a specific date.
Start of the service/route list. Each number becomes one invoice line and one day in Schedule. Drivers can differ per number.
Unit code or car type, e.g. ARA, FCB, VLZ1, Innova.
Internal: short name/tag is enough. External: must have name + phone + origin.
External driver's base, e.g. Bandung, Bogor, Jakarta.
Price per service line. The order total is computed from all lines.
Allowed for locations/times not yet confirmed, especially the next day.

mistakes: External drivers cannot be just a tag. Write name + WhatsApp number + origin/base.
Do not forget the Price on each detail line, because the invoice is computed from the service lines.
REVISED, CANCELLED, or DRAFT invoices cannot be sent to the customer's WhatsApp.
If the invoice has no PDF yet, generate/sync the invoice first before sending.
If an internal driver tag fails to match, make sure the driver's WhatsApp number in the database is correct.

orderDetail.invoiceExceedsHint: Edit order price upward or revise/cancel invoices before creating more invoices.

orderDetail.okNoPhone: No customer phone number on this order
orderDetail.okDriverReassigned: Driver reassigned on all upcoming days
orderDetail.reassignAllHint: Overwrites the driver & car on every service day that hasn't started yet. Days already in progress, done, or cancelled are left untouched.
orderDetail.assignForAllHint: Applies this driver & car to every service line that has no driver yet. Use the per-day Change button to override a single day.
orderDetail.readOnlyDesc: Order details, service days, driver assignment, and charges are locked. Billing actions (invoices, payment, receipt, refund) are still available.
orderDetail.finalizeConfirmHint: All service days are finished. Finalizing closes the order (marks it Done). Make sure ops cost and driver fee are recorded first.
orderDetail.finalizeAdditionalWarning: This order has additional charges. Before finalizing, double-check the additional items, ops cost, and driver fee are all correct — finalizing closes the order.
orderDetail.cancelWarning: This cancels the whole order: all upcoming days are cancelled, drivers/cars released, active invoices voided, and a cancellation fee is issued per Arasya policy. This cannot be undone.
orderDetail.okOrderCancelled: Order cancelled and cancellation fee issued
orderDetail.cancelRefundHint: The customer overpaid versus the cancellation fee. Process the refund via the Mark Refund flow.
orderDetail.awaitingDpAssign: A driver can be assigned once the customer pays the DP. Create a Down Payment (DP) invoice, then mark it paid with the transfer proof. Days served by a partner can still be set.
